name: breadcrumbs
description: An always-on pane with what this session is about: the task, your last prompt, what Claude is doing and last said, and the explanations it wrote, saved as notes you can preview.

panel.title: Open the pane
panel.description: auto opens it when a session starts; command opens it only with /whereami.

model.title: Side-pass model
model.description: The model that reads each turn to keep the task, decisions, attempts and missed explanations up to date.

testerModel.title: Tester model
testerModel.description: The model manual-test testers run on, unless the plan sets one for a test; inherit uses the session's model.

retentionDays.title: Keep sessions (days)
retentionDays.description: A session folder untouched this long, or whose worktree is gone, is archived.

archiveDays.title: Keep archive (days)
archiveDays.description: How long an archived session folder stays before it is deleted.

archive.title: Archive before deleting
archive.description: Off deletes stale session folders outright instead of archiving them first.
